name: Epic Universe Coasters
intro: Epic Universe launched with four coasters that together span every intensity level — from a family launch coaster your 8-year-old can handle to a 62-mph twin-track beast that ranks among the best in the United States. None of them are filler.

rides.blurb: The 'boom coaster' concept — simulating riding a mine cart launching off broken track — sounds gimmicky until you're on it. DK theming so well done that you forget it's the park's tamest coaster.
Two launches, Toothless appearances, and a 75-foot layout that threads through Isle of Berk's dragon village. The one Universal designed to make coaster skeptics into converts.

Forward through the haunted forest, then launched backwards through a barn while your car spins. Under 2 minutes, perfectly calibrated. Mack's spinning launch tech has never been deployed this effectively.

5,000 feet of twin Mack track, 62 mph, a one-of-a-kind inverted crisscross element, and synchronized on-board audio. Both the best coaster in the park and one of the top 5 in Florida. Ride it twice — once in daylight, once in the dark.
